flagged.evidence: The entry says the chain rule means “the encoder gradient differentiates through the fixed-noise map.” But `def-pathwise-simulation-gradient-estimator` gives its componentwise chain-rule formula only when the inner map and outer payoff are differentiable. This theorem assumes only that the full payoff H_i is C1; it does not assume g_phi or the separate log-density factors are differentiable.
